name: Blue Beacon Marina
column29: Full-service family-owned marina at the Narrows between Lake Simcoe and Lake Couchiching. Offers a fuel dock, free pump-out for residents, convenience store, certified marine technician with 37 years experience, new and used boat sales (Princecraft, Yamaha, Mercury), and year-round storage. Also rents boats and personal watercraft.

name: Bridgeport Marina
address: 434 Couchiching Point Rd, Orillia, ON L3V 6P8
column28: Full-service marina on Lake Couchiching at the Atherley Narrows. Offers 91 premium non-ethanol gas and diesel, a fully stocked chandlery, certified service technicians, towing, yacht brokerage, and dockside store. Showers on site.

name: Port of Orillia
description: Transient-only municipal marina with modern floating docks, private shower/washroom pods, and free laundry on a beautiful waterfront boardwalk. No gas or pump-out on site. Steps from downtown Orillia restaurants, Metro grocery, and LCBO. WiFi available near the office.

name: Mariposa Landing
address: 430 Couchiching Point Road, Orillia, ON L3V 6P8
column28: Ontario's friendliest marina — a 20-acre park-like setting at the Narrows between Lake Simcoe and Lake Couchiching. Features 153 covered deep-water slips plus 30 open slips, hydro and city water at every slip, sewage pump-out, private washrooms and showers. Adjacent cycling trails lead into Tudhope Park and downtown Orillia.

name: Ojibway Bay Marina
description: Clean Marine Certified (5 Anchor/Gold Rating) marina on the east shore of Lake Couchiching, operated by Chippewas of Rama First Nation. On-dock Shell gas, pump-out, showers, retail kiosk, playground, and launch ramp. Walking distance to Casino Rama Resort and Tim Hortons. Online booking available.

name: Marina del Rey
description: Full-service marina in McPhee Bay on Lake Simcoe's east shore with 160 covered and open slips. 24-hour pump-out, certified marine technicians, fiberglass repair, well-stocked Boater's Store, heated swimming pool, WiFi, and yacht brokerage. Pet friendly. Year-round storage with 30-ton Marine Travelift.

name: Starport Marina
address: 3952 McRae Park Road, Ramara, ON L3V 0S2
description: Premium destination lifestyle marina on 57 acres on Lake Simcoe's northeast shore. Diamond Elite Clean Marine certified. Heated saltwater pool, boater's lounge, off-leash dog run, fire pit, beach volleyball, and docking assistance. Mobile pump-out, Volvo/Mercury/Diesel certified technicians, and yacht sales. Welcomes both members and transient boaters.

name: McGregor on the Water
description: Full-service marina at the top end of Lake Couchiching near Lock 42 on the Trent-Severn Waterway, 10 minutes north of Orillia. Ethanol-free gas and diesel, pump-out, Mercury/Mercruiser certified technicians, Avalon pontoon and Mercury outboard dealer, new and used boat sales, and heated indoor/outdoor winter storage.

name: Lauderdale Point Marina & Resort
address: 3500 Lauderdale Point Crescent, Severn Bridge, ON P0E 1N0
column28: Full-service marina and resort on Sparrow Lake along the Trent-Severn Waterway, 90 minutes from Toronto. Ethanol-free gas and diesel, pump-out, covered and open slips, boat rentals, camping and RV sites, cottage rentals, LCBO outlet, convenience store, and a licensed patio and restaurant.
